summary: Master the art of hotel revenue management with our specialized training. Learn the effective pricing strategies to boost your hotel's financial performance.
lede: Hotel revenue management and pricing strategies help you move beyond occupancy by forecasting demand, structuring prices, controlling inventory, and evaluating profitability across segments, room types, channels, markets, and stay dates. You will use measures including RevPAR, ADR, GOPPAR, TRevPAR, occupancy, and market penetration alongside STR market data and USALI reporting categories to assess commercial value. The course takes you from market diagnosis through forecast construction, pricing design, distribution review, and executive reporting. You will practise demand calendars, booking pace analysis, room-type price ladders, displacement evaluation, overbooking limits, channel contribution scorecards, Excel-based analysis, and Power BI-style dashboard logic, while gaining operational awareness of machine learning forecasts, dynamic pricing algorithms, and automated decision rules.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for hotel professionals who influence room pricing, demand planning, inventory availability, distribution, or commercial reporting. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who already work with hotel operating data and want a more disciplined revenue management process.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet capability. The course uses provided hotel datasets and templates, so you do not need access to live property systems. Coding is not required. Advanced revenue science, machine learning forecasting, and automated pricing are introduced at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, while forecasting, pricing matrices, inventory controls, channel analysis, and reporting receive hands-on practice.
